# netbox_object_change (Data Source)

Reads a single NetBox object change (`/api/core/object-changes/`) by `id` or filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated by internal/gen; edit generator/overrides to change, or remove this line to hand-maintain.
data "netbox_object_change" "example" {
  id = 123
}

# Lookup by arbitrary API filters:
data "netbox_object_change" "filtered" {
  filters = [
    { name = "id", value = "123" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes List) Additional query filters as name/value pairs, e.g. `{ name = "tenant_id", value = "12" }`. Any query parameter of `/api/core/object-changes/` is accepted. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the object in NetBox.

### Read-Only

- `action` (String) Action.
- `changed_object` (String) Changed Object.
- `changed_object_id` (Number) Changed Object Id.
- `changed_object_type` (String) Changed Object Type.
- `display` (String) Display.
- `display_url` (String) Display Url.
- `message` (String) Message.
- `object_repr` (String) Object Repr.
- `postchange_data` (String) Postchange Data.
- `prechange_data` (String) Prechange Data.
- `request_id` (String) Request Id.
- `time` (String) Time.
- `url` (String) Url.
- `user_id` (Number) User. References `netbox_user`.
- `user_name` (String) User Name.

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `name` (String) Query parameter name.
- `value` (String) Query parameter value.
